name: ArabicSense
description: ArabicSense is a benchmark designed to evaluate commonsense reasoning abilities of large language models in Arabic. It includes three tasks: distinguishing sensible from nonsensical statements, identifying reasons for nonsensical statements, and generating explanations for nonsensical statements.
reputation: A niche Arabic commonsense benchmark with limited but growing use in Arabic LLM evaluation.
notes: Addresses the gap in Arabic commonsense reasoning evaluation; includes multiple tasks and reports model performance improvements after fine-tuning.
